domainAssumptions: candidate mechanisms can be separated by corrective experiments
records.proposedTransfer: Represent uncertainty by origin and require a discriminating action instead of a confidence adjective.

domainAssumptions: builder and evaluator can be isolated
behavior can be rebound to component and source traces
records.proposedTransfer: Keep builders and evaluators independent and bind observed behavior through trace to responsible source.

domainAssumptions: experimental initial conditions can be recorded and replayed
records.proposedTransfer: Place stochastic proposals inside a deterministic seeded shell; expose cross-seed variance, anchoring, and memory contamination.

domainAssumptions: local niche competition preserves useful diversity
records.proposedTransfer: Retain Pareto survivors across independent semantic, mechanism, causal, and implementation niches.

domainAssumptions: problems and solutions admit compatible encodings
solutions can transfer between generated environments
records.proposedTransfer: Allow surviving candidates to provoke discriminating challenges and transfer stepping stones between niches.

domainAssumptions: agent source can be safely modified and empirically validated
records.proposedTransfer: Do not transfer direct modification of the active organism; the Soma cannot rewrite Bone or itself.

domainAssumptions: diverse descendants can retain useful stepping stones
records.proposedTransfer: Borrow only the lineage archive: descendants are quarantined values and never replace a running organism.

domainAssumptions: local update rules can converge toward a stable morphology
damage exposure can broaden a basin of attraction
records.proposedTransfer: Translate damage exposure into corruption, tool-loss, resource-loss, and adversarial-input trials for descendants.

domainAssumptions: an evaluator can score correctness automatically
records.proposedTransfer: Use isolated islands and asynchronous embodiment only where executable discriminators exist.

domainAssumptions: open-ended dynamics require longitudinal rather than anecdotal measurement
records.proposedTransfer: Measure change, novelty, complexity, and ecological potential separately; never call endless execution growth.
